profile.headline: Senior Associate Software Developer (C#.Net, Full Stack) at PricewaterhouseCoopers
profile.summary: Hard working, detail-oriented, and creative individual that will provide a technical company with the utilization of my skills in web development and/or software design

positions.title: Senior Associate Software Developer
positions.description:
Developing an MVC C# tax form management site over a multi tenanted database. 
Creating SSMS, Oracle stored procedures, functions, views and statements for apps. 
Utilizing Microsoft best practices, patterns for 100+ ft. req’s: maint. and new functionality. 
Architecting jQuery plugins, AngularJS apps, and RESTful APIs for client side dev.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed the Rater, an ASP.NET logistics management system in C#/VB.
Created MSSQL stored procedures, functions, views and statements for apps.
Authored a 340+ page Adobe RoboHelp documentation system for tech support.
Lead development for 40+ feature requests: maintenance and new functionality.

Specifically, I am responsible for programming new requirements and features as dictated by the Cerasis design team, who take all new emerging technological standards and any new TMS features needed to keep up with the fast paced and highly changing world of transportation and then send to developers like me to make those desired changes and features a reality. Furthermore, I create and maintain the "Help Documentation" that you see when you click the "Help" button at the top of the Cerasis Rater.

positions.title: Web Content Manager
positions.description:
Creating, developing and managing content for Remwood’s web presence (Joomla! 1.5). 
Copyediting and proofreading all web content. 
Assuring web-based information is archived for future needs and reference. 
Tracking and reporting on all site metrics.

positions.title: Student IT Help Desk
positions.description:
Provided IT support over the phone for on-campus students
Maintained the computer labs and IT support via data entry

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed ASP.Net POS applications in Visual Basic and C#
Generated efficient database queries using MySQL, Oracle and MSSQL
Tested development sites with scrutiny before publishing to AWS server

positions.title: Admissions Office - Communications Assistant
positions.description:
Provided IT support over the phone for on-campus students.
Tested with feedback on bugs and browser compatibility for beta email system.
Maintained the computer labs and IT support via data entry.

positions.title: Summer Camp Counselor
positions.description: Monitored the kids and summer camp events
